analysis.title: Boise Cascade Co. (BCC): 3Q26 First Take
key_insights: BCC reported 3Q26 EPS of $1.04, above GS's $0.99 estimate but below FactSet consensus of $1.12.

The beat versus GS came from an adj. EBIT margin of 3.1%, 20bps above GS's forecast, worth +$0.07 to EPS, partly offset by taxes (-$0.02). Revenue up 8% YOY versus GSe +7% was offset by a higher share count (+/- $0.01).
4Q consolidated adj. EBITDA guide of $43mn at the midpoint is well below GS's $78mn forecast and consensus of $76mn, with both segments contributing to the miss.
Building Materials Distribution (BMD) revenue rose 7% YOY (volumes +2%, price +5%), in line with GSe +7%, driven by commodities (+15%). General line (+4%) and EWP (+1%) underperformed.
BMD segment EBIT margin fell 42bps YOY but was 56bps above GSe. Higher selling and distribution expenses and lower general line profitability were partly offset by higher commodity gross margins.
Wood Products sales grew 16% YOY versus GSe +10%, helped by plywood pricing (+31%), LVL volumes (+18%) and I-joist shipments (+10%), partly offset by lower plywood volumes (-7%).
Wood Products segment EBIT margin improved 653bps YOY to 3.5%, but was 158bps below GS's forecast, as higher per-unit conversion costs weighed on results.

Net debt/EBITDA was 0.2x at 3Q versus 0.4x in 2Q and -0.2x a year ago, with $780mn of available liquidity. Buybacks were ~$2.8mn in the quarter and ~$5mn in October, with ~$120mn left on the authorization.
2026 capex guide was cut by $30mn to $120-140mn versus GSe of $163mn.

GS is Neutral with an $85 12-month price target based on 7.8x its Q5-Q8 EBITDA estimate. Questions for the call include the 4Q guide, the composite decking and siding supplier transition in BMD, price versus volume in BMD, inventories, out-of-warehouse sales, EWP volumes versus price, and broader inflation.

market_movers.rationale: Neutral rating and $85 target kept after a 3Q EPS beat versus GS but a 4Q EBITDA guide far below GS and consensus. Price of $75 implies 13.3% upside to target.

sector_views.rationale: Housing is decelerating and inflation is broad. Higher commodity prices, especially plywood, helped offset these pressures at BCC.

earnings_insights: BCC 3Q26 EPS $1.04 reported (reported 11/2) vs GS estimate $0.99 and FactSet consensus $1.12, so a beat versus GS and a miss versus consensus.
BCC 3Q26 revenue grew 8% YOY versus GS estimate of +7%.
BCC 3Q26 adj. EBIT margin was 3.1%, 20bps above GS's forecast.
BCC 4Q26 consolidated adj. EBITDA guide is $43mn at the midpoint (company guidance) versus GS estimate $78mn and consensus estimate $76mn.
risk_factors: Upside risks: a greater-than-expected rally in wood product prices, gain of a new supplier in building materials distribution, and effective capital allocation that supports growth.
Downside risks: lower-than-forecast utilization rates, inability to pass through higher input costs, and wildfires and infestations affecting raw material sourcing.
Deceleration in housing and consumer confidence, along with broader inflation, pressures volumes and margins.
